description: This file contains the implementation of the EmailAuthenticateUser class, which extends the SugarAuthenticateUser class to handle email-based user authentication, including login process, session management, and email notifications within the SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: EmailAuthenticateUser
classes.description: Handles email-based user authentication, session tokens, and email notifications in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Manages user login, generating email session tokens, and validating session data.

methods.name: sendEmailPassword
methods.description: Sends an authentication token to the user's email address.
